description: Take up to 25 products off sale on Amazon: the offer's quantity becomes 0 on every marketplace it exists on (nobody can buy it) — the offer is NOT deleted and keeps its history and reviews in Seller Central — and the product leaves the CRM's Amazon channel so the hourly push does not restore the quantity; adding it to the channel again (set_channel_membership) brings it back. Not gated on the owner's arming (taking an offer down never is), but refused until the owner switches on AI publishing. Returns per product: withdrawn, blocked (noListing, listingNotFound, variationParent, fulfilledByAmazon, noOffer = Amazon holds the item with no offer on it, so there is nothing to take off sale), rejected (Amazon's sentences) or failed; notAttempted to call again. With marketplaceIds only those stores are zeroed and the other stores keep selling; the product leaves the CRM's Amazon channel only when no store is left selling. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceIds.description: Only these Amazon stores, by id. The product keeps selling everywhere else and stays on the channel; publishing it on such a store again puts it back on sale. Omit to take it off every store.

productIds.description: The products to take off sale, at most 25 ids.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
